description: Company dossier with unmasked details and risk signals. Set cnia_atual=true to require a CNIA source check during this request; failure returns 503 without charging or using an older record. Otherwise, inspect the returned CNIA date. Read GET /api/dossie/preco before spending. The same credit holder reopening that company on the same Brasília day is not charged again. The service assembles the record and applies the risk rules. Read dossie.dados, dossie.semaforo.alertas and dossie.semaforo.sem_conferencia instead of coding the join and rules. Missing checks are not a clean result. This is a screening aid, not an official certificate or a guarantee that a supplier is safe.

cnia_atual.description: Require a CNIA source check during this request. If it fails, return 503 without charging or using a previous record. When selecting topics, include sancoes.

cnpj.description: CNPJ without punctuation: 14 digits or the alphanumeric one (12 letters or digits and 2 check digits), such as 12ABC34501DE35.
